name: RxNorm_get_drug_names
description: Get RXCUI (RxNorm Concept Unique Identifier) and all associated names (generic names, brand names, synonyms, etc.) for a drug by its name. This tool uses the RxNorm API from the U.S. National Library of Medicine (NLM) to standardize drug names.

drug_name.description: The name of the drug to search for (e.g., 'ibuprofen', 'aspirin', 'acetaminophen'). Can be a generic name, brand name, or any drug name variant.

label: drug
medication
pharmaceutical
RxNorm
NLM
standardization
rxcui

concepts.description: The same names RxNorm returned, with the labels it attached to them. `names` is a flat list of strings, so 'aspirin' the ingredient and 'Pamprin Max Formula' the brand arrive indistinguishable and neither carries the rxcui that would let it be looked up. NOTE: `names` holds one entry more than this list - the concept's own main name, which comes from RxNorm's properties endpoint rather than its related-concepts endpoint, so it has no term type to report. The difference is not a dropped row.

rxcui.description: RxNorm identifier of THIS concept, e.g. '1052413'. Distinct from the top-level rxcui, which is the concept that was searched for.

name.description: The name, as it appears in `names`.

tty.description: RxNorm term type: 'IN' ingredient, 'BN' brand name, 'SCD' semantic clinical drug, 'SBD' semantic branded drug, 'PIN' precise ingredient. This is what separates an ingredient from a branded pack, and the flat list of names could not.

suppress.description: RxNorm's suppression flag: 'N' is active. A suppressed concept is obsolete and should not be presented as current.

synonym.description: RxNorm's synonym for the concept, when it records one.
